bullets.text: The US Treasury Secretary stated that Iran faces the 'greatest financial offensive ever,' with the US planning to sever all economic ties and isolate any nation financially partnering with Iran.
The UK Prime Minister has pledged continued support for Ukraine, despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia regarding the reported use of British drones.
A video has emerged showing hundreds of people held captive after a mosque kidnapping in Dekara village, Nigeria, where gunmen attacked worshippers and took women, children, and older individuals.
A former NSW police officer has alleged she was raped by a senior male colleague, who she claims is still in the force and had a reputation for preying on women.
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is facing continued pressure from various states to reform the GST distribution, after he affirmed his commitment to Western Australia's current funding arrangement.
The Ombudsman has criticised police following the wrongful arrest and search of an Indigenous teenager on a bus, expressing concern that police lacked a clear understanding of racial profiling.

Former US President Donald Trump announced plans to increase tariffs on Canadian cars to 50%, signaling a further escalation in trade tensions between Washington and Ottawa. This move has caused concern among Canadian businesses, who fear economic pain and uncertainty.

Shein, the fast-fashion retailer, has reportedly listed in Hong Kong at a quarter of its peak value, marking a significant decline from its previous $100 billion valuation. The company has faced several challenges and false starts over the years.
UK power equipment rental firm Aggreko Plc has filed for a US initial public offering (IPO), revealing that the private equity-backed company has become profitable as its revenue increased.
